name: Sluice
description: Water leaving a sluice: a narrow throat opening into a wide fan.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 42%; top: 0; width: 16%; height: 42%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 222deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 96deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 0%, transparent 40%, #000 0); mask: conic-gradient(from 222deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 96deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 0%, transparent 40%, #000 0); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
